alloydb.summary: Cluster, instance, and user CRUD with LRO operations — no connectable PostgreSQL server.

cloud-kms.summary: Key rings, crypto keys/versions, symmetric encrypt/decrypt, asymmetric sign/decrypt, MAC, random bytes.

cloud-scheduler.summary: Job CRUD, pause/resume, and cron execution.

cloud-sql.summary: Instance, database, and user admin API — PostgreSQL only; instances expose a real Postgres endpoint backed by PGlite.

cloud-storage.summary: Bucket CRUD, object upload/download, copy, compose, and rewrite.

cloud-tasks.summary: Queue lifecycle, task CRUD, and HTTP dispatch.

memorystore.summary: Instance, ACL, backup, and token-auth CRUD; optional real Valkey data plane on by default.

pubsub.summary: Topics, subscriptions, publish/pull, ack, snapshots, schemas, and seek.

secret-manager.summary: Config flag exists; service is a stub with no routes yet.

workflows.summary: Workflow CRUD, revisions, and LRO operations.
